SELECT p.category, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN p2.purchase_date >= '2024-04-01' AND p2.purchase_date < '2024-07-01' THEN p2.total_amount ELSE 0 END) as q2_revenue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p2.purchase_date >= '2024-07-01' AND p2.purchase_date < '2024-10-01' THEN p2.total_amount ELSE 0 END) as q3_revenue
FROM products p
JOIN purchases p2 ON p.product_id = p2.product_id
WHERE (p2.purchase_date >= '2024-04-01' AND p2.purchase_date < '2024-10-01')
GROUP BY p.category

SELECT p.category, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN p2.purchase_date >= '2024-04-01' AND p2.purchase_date < '2024-07-01' THEN p2.total_amount ELSE 0 END) as q2_revenue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p2.purchase_date >= '2024-07-01' AND p2.purchase_date < '2024-10-01' THEN p2.total_amount ELSE 0 END) as q3_revenue,
       ((SUM(CASE WHEN p2.purchase_date >= '2024-07-01' AND p2.purchase_date < '2024-10-01' THEN p2.total_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN p2.purchase_date >= '2024-04-01' AND p2.purchase_date < '2024-07-01' THEN p2.total_amount ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN p2.purchase_date >= '2024-04-01' AND p2.purchase_date < '2024-07-01' THEN p2.total_amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100 as pct_change
FROM products p
JOIN purchases p2 ON p.product_id = p2.product_id
WHERE (p2.purchase_date >= '2024-04-01' AND p2.purchase_date < '2024-10-01')
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY pct_change ASC

SELECT user_id, MIN(purchase_date) as first_purchase_date FROM purchases GROUP BY user_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) as user_count
FROM purchases p
JOIN (SELECT user_id, MIN(purchase_date) as first_purchase_date FROM purchases GROUP BY user_id) fp
ON p.user_id = fp.user_id
WHERE p.purchase_date > fp.first_purchase_date
AND julianday(p.purchase_date) - julianday(fp.first_purchase_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 30
